ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels to 55% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs occupy the lateral-medial regions of both lobes; the left lobe white region contains a dense field of dark pixel-spots (mottling), while the right lobe white region is more fragmented and contains a distinct vertical dark linear interruption.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 52 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with 12 to 15 distinct sawtooth peaks per lobe; pixel amplitudes of these peaks vary between 5 and 20 pixels from the local boundary baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory originating from the central notch, transitioning into a sharp upward concave sweep toward the distal fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of textured, high-contrast, roughly circular objects (barnacle colonies) localized on the terminal distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned white linear pixel streaks detected on the inner right lobe white patch and middle region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation on the margins of both distal fluke tips; presence of scattered white circular pits (potential scars) on the dark central peduncle region.
other_distinctive_markers: A notable dark vertical pigmentation void bisecting the lower portion of the white patch on the right lobe.
